_note: Scheduled deployments served by `serve.py`. `enabled` is the source of truth: flip it here and restart the serve process (or `make restart`). Everything starts disabled so this project can run side by side with the n8n deployment without sending duplicate emails; enable at cutover. Crons are evaluated in `timezone`. n8n's weekly triggers were 'every 7 days at 06:00' (floating weekday); they are pinned to Monday here.
